summary: IDOT clarified that the typical cross sections were not intended to depict actual ground surface undulations outside the highway rights-of-way, and that all drainage would be in accordance with provisions established by the General Assembly and contained in the Illinois Revised Statutes.
text: 2(c) The typical proposed cross sections (in Exhibit 2) are not intended to depict the actual ground surface undulations at or outside the highway rights-of-way. All drainage will be in accordance, with the provisions and limitations established by the General Assembly and contained in the Illinois Revised Statutes.
